title: Fixed Empty Vertical Spit and Panel Roaster

One continuous upper cantilever ends in a fixed spindle housing above a single long vertical shaft, with a lower seat and empty round support disc over a true shallow drip tray with a complete floor and raised rim. Three blank side controls finish the entire static appliance. It is not a horizontal skewer trough turned upright or a cavity oven with its door removed. No food, flame, heating or emission, powered rotation, cooking performance, hygiene, food contact, operation, manufacture, load or safety certification. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
